result:
I’d make **basic security a right rather than a privilege**—ensuring everyone can afford food, shelter, healthcare, education, and enough breathing room to recover from setbacks. Not luxury. Just a floor beneath which no one falls.

I’d choose that because so much of the world’s cruelty, defensiveness, and pointless competition seems to grow out of fear. When people don’t feel one missed paycheck or one illness could destroy them, they have more room to be generous, curious, and patient. The change wouldn’t make people perfect, but it might make their mistakes less cruel to one another.
